steps.title: Label prices below 200
steps.added_sql:
SELECT ProductID, Product, Sale_Price,
       CASE
           WHEN Sale_Price < 200 THEN 'Budget'
       END AS price_band
FROM Products
ORDER BY ProductID ASC;

steps.title: Add the Mid range
steps.sql:
SELECT ProductID, Product, Sale_Price,
       CASE
           WHEN Sale_Price < 200 THEN 'Budget'
           WHEN Sale_Price >= 200 AND Sale_Price < 700 THEN 'Mid'
       END AS price_band
FROM Products
ORDER BY ProductID ASC;
